card.name: Inside long split medical terms
card.fires_on: Middle or end pieces of long words split into parts, such as phosphodiesterase, atrioventricular and dissipation. It fires on the piece just before the word is complete.

modes.label: Phosphodiesterase
modes.description: The 'ester' or 'ase' piece inside phosphodiesterase, in drug interaction text about PDE-5 inhibitors.

modes.label: Atrioventricular
modes.description: The 'ricular' piece of atrioventricular in conduction warnings.

modes.label: Dissipation factor
modes.description: The 'ipation' piece of dissipation in material specifications.
